toolchain.note: Mandated MINIMUMS for this repo and every consuming remote — see the 'Toolchain baseline' section of CLAUDE.md. FuzeFront is the Module-Federation host, so moduleFederationRequiredVersion must be identical here and in every remote or the remote loads its own React copy and fails with 'Invalid hook call'. Raising the floor is fine; lowering it is a breaking change to the family. Declarative only — no CI gate reads this today.

identity.note: Prefix namespace for this product's entity types (governance/identifier-standard.md §2, baseline v1.5.0). DECLARED here rather than derived from the repo directory name: a rename would otherwise silently orphan every id already issued, and that surfaces much later as unresolvable references with no obvious cause. FuzeFront mints only RESERVED SPINE prefixes (usr/org/prt/app, the billing set, the messaging set) because it hosts those services for the whole family — a product's own types namespace as front_<type>. Enforced by `gate_identifier.py --namespace`, whose spine table names the owning repo per prefix.

mcp.note: GATEWAY dialect — the shared @fuzefront/mcp-gateway image (packages/mcp-gateway, published by this repo), not per-repo server code. Deployed in-cluster by deploy/helm/fuzefront/templates/mcp-gateway.yaml (mcp.enabled=true in every values overlay, pinned image tag), fronting the app-registry contract at services/app-registry-service/openapi.yaml with mutation overrides in deploy/helm/fuzefront/files/mcp-tools.overrides.yaml. ClusterIP only, not exposed through ingress — the gateway forwards the caller's bearer token upstream and holds no credential of its own. This block previously declared a stdio scaffold (mcp/server.ts, enabled:false) that had already been superseded by the gateway in production; the scaffold is deleted (see mcp/ removal) rather than kept as a second, dead implementation. Owned by mcp-maintainer for upkeep of this block/deployment wiring; tool behaviour is the app-registry-service contract, owned by backend-engineer.
